products.product_description: White Cheddar 5906-KD is a non-GMO White Cheddar Cheese Blend dried cheese powder. Product was shipped in bulk bags, net wt 50 lbs. The product label is read in parts: "***WHITE CHEDDAR BLEND 5906KD *** Net Wt. 50 lbs. ***INGREDIENTS: CHEDDAR CHEESE (Pasteurized Milk, Salt, Cheese Culture, Enzymes), WHEY, BUTTER MILK, SALT, DISODIUM PHOSPHATE. Contains less than 2% Silicon Dioxide as anti-caking agent ***ALLERGEN: MILK ***STORAGE: Store in a clean, dry, cool (<80 F) location *** COUNTRY OF ORIGIN: USA ***Commercial Creamery Company ***218 South Birch St. Jerome, ID ***".
products.reason_for_recall: White Cheddar Blend is recalled due to a potential contamination with Salmonella.
